action_items: CRITICAL: Configure the Kubernetes ingress/proxy/nginx to NOT override Cache-Control headers set by the FastAPI backend. The backend correctly sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=300' on /api/games/comment-counts and 'public, max-age=60' on /api/games, but the proxy replaces them with 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. This prevents any CDN or browser caching benefit from the optimization. Look for ingress annotations or nginx config that sets cache headers globally — e.g., nginx `add_header Cache-Control 'no-store...'` in server block, or a Traefik/NGINX ingress middleware.
critical_code_review_comments: Cache-Control header proxy override: The proxy layer is overriding backend-set Cache-Control headers. The fix should be in the ingress/proxy config — either remove the global no-store header directive, or use proxy_pass_header / proxy_hide_header to let backend headers through.

rca_of_issue: Root Cause: The Kubernetes ingress/reverse proxy has a global Cache-Control override directive that sets 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on ALL responses regardless of what the upstream FastAPI backend returns. Reproduction: curl -si https://hypd-games-fast.preview.emergentagent.com/api/games/comment-counts | grep -i cache → returns 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. vs curl -si http://localhost:8001/api/games/comment-counts | grep -i cache → returns 'public, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=600'. Mitigation: In the nginx/ingress config, either remove the global `add_header Cache-Control 'no-store...'` directive, or conditionally only apply no-store to auth/dynamic routes while allowing public game endpoints to pass through.
